follow-up time: from the first visit till delivery
cohort: The study included 100 women aged between 18-45 years with first trimester vaginal bleeding and 100 normal pregnant women without first trimester vaginal bleeding as a control group.
finding: First trimester vaginal bleeding was associated with a higher risk of abortion and preterm delivery.
mod_finding: The majority of patients in both groups had a vaginal delivery (64% in the bleeding group and 71% in the control group), while 15% of cases and 20% of controls had a caesarean section.
